title: F9: cross-record reexec_of check in verify
outcome: Verify checks each reexec_of target is a sig_ok hold record with the same envelope_hash, an executed unhold in between, re-executed at most once
acceptance: Hand-built record with reexec_of to a non-hold record -> TAMPER reexec_invalid at that seq
Two records re-executing the same hold -> TAMPER reexec_invalid at the second
Re-exec without an intervening executed unhold action:<record_id> -> TAMPER reexec_invalid; clean hero record OK
